description: Exports ONE block as SimaticML XML and returns it INLINE with sha256, normalizedSha256 and bytes — no file on the serve host. `contentHash` is the stale-write guard hash: the SHA-256 of this block's export with the DEFAULT options after removing volatile noise (Created, InstalledProducts, formatting tokens, line endings, layout whitespace between tags; whitespace INSIDE text, comments and string values is part of the hash) and renumbering the UIds canonically, so a renumbering by TIA never changes it while a rewiring does; the serve computes it, so it stays the default-options hash even when you ask for other options, and it exists only for a well-formed XML export: otherwise the XML is still returned, `contentHash` is absent and `contentHashError` says why. `normalizedSha256` is the tia_block_compare normalization (it ignores UIds) and `sha256` is the hash of the raw text. `contentHash`, `normalizedSha256` and `sha256` are different hash contracts over different normalizations: never substitute one for another, and pass only the `contentHash` of a fresh read as `expectedContentHash`. Pass the `contentHash` as `expectedContentHash` to tia_import_xml or tia_source_put and the write is refused with 409 state_changed if the block changed in the project after this read (the guarded write itself never compiles: a block that is not consistent is refused with 409 inconsistent — compile, re-read with this tool, retry; one whose current export is not well-formed XML is refused with 409 unverifiable); an older serve returns no contentHash. Read-mostly — it does not change code/data, but the export may compile an inconsistent block first if needed (export requires consistency), which can regenerate its instance DB; treated as read for agent tool policy. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/xml. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
name: tia_export_block
title: TIA — export one block (SimaticML, inline)
